basis: User authorized bounded local experiments. Only the specified reviewed candidate, checkpoint, share and schedule are included; this is not general data approval.
limitations: Only 57 pairs and 4841 assistant targets; repeated sampling may severely overfit.
Two model reviews do not establish factual correctness, privacy, rights, or independence from ancestor training.
